description: Desktop telemetry analysis tool for MoTeC data (CSV/LD/LDX) and live simulator capture (AMS2, AC EVO). C++ Builder 12 VCL application.

architecture.pattern: Rule-based analysis engine with alias abstraction layer

layers.name: Data Ingestion
layers.description: Parse CSV/LD/LDX files or read live shared memory into LapStats structures

layers.name: Alias Resolution (DataProvider)
layers.description: Maps raw channel names to semantic aliases per simulator profile. Supports virtual channels (e.g. Rake). Configured via MotecDataAnalyser.mapping.json

layers.name: Rule Engine (AnalysisRegistry)
layers.description: Evaluates independent AnalysisRule instances against DataProvider. Each rule declares requiredInputs() and returns AnalysisResult. Currently 4 rules: EngineTemperature, TyreTemperature, TyrePressure, HandlingBalance

layers.name: Report Generation
layers.description: Maps AnalysisResults to report sections. Generates structured ReportResult for UI display

layers.name: UI (VCL)
layers.description: Main form with report tabs, GDI+ paint boxes for tyre temps and damper histograms. Threshold editor dialog. Live capture controls

disabled_pipeline.description: Structured Recommendation pipeline (computeConfidence, dataQualityLabel, applyRuleToRecommendation) was removed as dead code. CauseEntry and Recommendation structs exist in MotecSetupAnalyzer.h but are not wired to the active engine.
disabled_pipeline.status: pending re-wire when report engine is extended

files.name: MotecDataAnalyser.ini
files.purpose: UI options (language, profile, full-report, last folder)

files.name: MotecDataAnalyser.thresholds.ini
files.purpose: Numeric thresholds + SymptomWeights overrides. Restart required after edits

files.name: MotecDataAnalyser.rules.json
files.purpose: Optional custom symptoms/aliases/weights. Fallback: buildDefaults() in code

files.name: MotecDataAnalyser.mapping.json
files.purpose: Channel alias mappings per profile + virtual channels

completed: Cleanup: removed hardcoded analysis logic, centralized thresholds in AnalysisSettings
Mapping abstraction: DataProvider + alias system + external mapping.json
Rule-based engine: AnalysisRule/AnalysisRegistry with 4 initial rules
Virtual channels: Rake via ride-height difference
in_progress: Source channel decoupling: replace direct channel dispatch in analyze_motec_setup.cpp with DataProvider ingestion (depends on mapping source/profile definition)
planned: UI Dispatcher: route AnalysisResults to the correct TTab dynamically
Cross-validation: test with AMS2 Motec file + AC EVO live session
Regression tests: verify no data loss through alias layer
Re-wire structured Recommendation pipeline when report engine is extended

key_principles: Simulator-agnostic: rules use semantic aliases, never raw channel names
Data-driven: symptoms/aliases/weights from RuleConfig (code + optional JSON), no recompile to add a symptom
Exe-relative paths: all file I/O anchored to executable directory
GDI+ rendering: all charts are custom GDI+, no TChart
